name: 集成到 SAP Enterprise Contract Assembly (2OQ)
name_en: Integration to SAP Enterprise Contract Assembly (2OQ)
description_en_html:
Overview

The SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition for enterprise contract management application enables digitization of legal transactions within an organization. This application facilitates creation and management of legal content in enterprises in alignment with core business processes and provides an integrated platform to run enterprise-wide legal process more efficiently.

SAP Enterprise Contract Assembly is an SAP BTP application that enables the authoring and assembly of the following legal content:

· Templates and text blocks as elements to reuse content

· Virtual documents as a result of the assembly of a template based on and specific business context

The integration of SAP Enterprise Contract Assembly with SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition for enterprise contract management enables enterprises to integrate with all core business processes, assemble all types of documents based on templates, text blocks, rules, and simultaneously store all documents in a central online repository.

Key Process Flow

  • Author or edit legal templates and documents
  • Assemble legal templates and documents
  • Generate legal documents
  • Manage legal documents

Business Benefits

  • Increase transparency on lifecycle of legal content creation and assembly
  • Experience efficient and faster provisioning of legal content
  • Get faster reaction times, lower risks, and improve compliance
description_zh_html:
概览

面向企业合同管理的 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 应用程序支持将组织内的法律事务数字化。此应用程序有助于根据核心业务流程创建和管理企业中的法律内容，并提供集成平台以更有效地运行企业范围内的法律流程。

SAP Enterprise Contract Assembly 是一个 SAP BTP 应用程序，可用于编写和组装以下法律内容：

· 模板和文本块作为重用内容的元素

· 根据特定业务上下文组装模板而产生的虚拟文档

SAP Enterprise Contract Assembly 与面向企业合同管理的 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 的集成使企业能够与所有核心业务流程集成，根据模板、文本块、规则组装所有类型的文档，同时将所有文档存储在中央在线资源库中。

关键流程流

  • 编写或编辑法律模板和文档
  • 汇编法律模板和文档
  • 生成法律文档
  • 管理法律文档

业务优势

  • 提高法律内容创建和组装生命周期的透明度。
  • 体验高效、快速的法律内容配置
  • 加快响应速度，降低风险，并提高合规性
